rich_description: The Employment and Employability Institute (e2i) is the labour-movement arm of NTUC that helps workers find jobs, upgrade their skills, and get back on their feet after retrenchment — running in parallel with Workforce Singapore but with stronger reach into union-affiliated and rank-and-file workers. e2i runs Career Coaching, job-matching events, Place-and-Train programmes (where the worker is hired first, then trained on the job with course fee subsidies of up to 90%), and Professional Conversion Programmes co-funded with WSG. It also operates retrenchment support clinics for affected workers when an employer announces large-scale layoffs, and the Operations and Technology Roadmap for low-wage workers in sectors like F&B, retail, and cleaning. NTUC membership is not required to use e2i services — non-members are welcome — but union members get additional career-credit subsidies and priority access to some courses. If you have a union, your union officer can warm-hand-off you to an e2i Career Coach.

other_criteria: Open to NTUC members and non-members; union members get enhanced course-fee subsidies
Rank-and-file and low-wage workers explicitly served by Place-and-Train and Operations and Technology Roadmap programmes
Retrenched workers can walk in for retrenchment support without prior appointment

required_documents.name: Resume
required_documents.notes: Career coach helps refine if outdated

oth_location: e2i operates centres at NTUC Income Tampines and at NTUC's e2i West (Devan Nair Institute). Career coaching is also available via online booking. PLACEHOLDER — verify whether NTUC has a dedicated counter at Tampines OTH.
typical_processing_time: Initial career coaching session: typically booked within 1-2 weeks. Place-and-Train placement: 4-12 weeks depending on sector.
